latest_release.body:
# OpenStock v2026.10.25

OpenStock is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) alternative to paid market platforms: track prices, watch the whole market and dig into company insights without a paywall. Use it at https://openstock-ods.vercel.app or self-host it with every feature.

This release covers everything on `main` up to #140. The previous tag was [`v2026.10.18`](https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock/releases/tag/v2026.10.18) ("October update"); the full history, with per-release credits, is on the [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog).

## What OpenStock does today

- **Markets:** a dashboard for US, India, Germany, Canada, Australia, Crypto and Forex, with an index pulse, sector heatmap, market leaders and top stories; ⌘K search across every exchange Finnhub covers; stocks open as tabs.
- **Stock pages:** TradingView charts with drawing tools and fullscreen (#118, #45), indicators that stay on every chart (#119), financials, technicals, company profile, and sentiment insights (#64). International tickers map correctly to TradingView (#57, #65, #117).
- **Watchlist and alerts:** a watchlist of up to 50 stocks (#127), price alerts by email in realtime mode, and a weekly AI-written news digest.
- **Accounts:** email and password sign-in, password reset (#71), live password requirements (#79), rate-limited auth, and a reset that signs out other devices (#125, #126).
- **AI providers:** Gemini, with MiniMax as an alternative provider (#61) and Siray.ai fallback (#40).
- **Self-hosting:** Docker and Docker Compose (#17), builds that need no database or secrets (#123), MongoDB kept private in Compose (#124), a prebuilt GHCR image on Node 22 (#128), one-click deploys on RepoCloud, ZopDay and Railway (#111, #115, #94), and an env checker (#104).
- **Community:** a changelog that credits every contributor (#130, #131), a Wall of love, and an in-app update banner (#129).

## New since v2026.10.18

- **Dividend yield card** on stock pages, using real Finnhub data, with a dash for stocks and crypto without a dividend. #137 (@samki6576)
- **Public, crawlable pages:** `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` are reachable signed-out, plus public, server-rendered company and guide pages (`/s`, `/compare`); the signed-in `/stocks/[symbol]` app is unchanged. #136
- **MiniMax defaults to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash** when `MINIMAX_MODEL` is unset, for primary requests and fallback; explicit overrides still work. #140 (@octo-patch)
- **Docker realtime mode works again:** `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE` is passed as a build arg, so Docker and Railway self-hosters can switch to realtime. #134
- **Dependency upgrades:** better-auth 1.3.25 → 1.7.10 (#132); nodemailer 7.0.6 → 10.1.2 and `@types/nodemailer` dropped, removing 81 packages from the lockfile (#133).
- **Docs and project health:** README rewritten to match how OpenStock works today (#135), Contributor Covenant 2.1 Code of Conduct (#139), FLOSS/fund funding manifest (`funding.json`) (#138).

#134 and #135 merged on 18 Oct 2026; #132, #133 and #136–#139 merged on 19 Oct 2026; #140 merged on 21 Oct 2026 (IST).

## Thank you

Everyone whose pull requests were merged into OpenStock:

@ravixalgorithm @keshav-005 @octo-patch @akoweicollinxx @chinnsenn @nb-src @CrixusWen @TPTBusiness @alexander-schneider @Bortlesboat @Chukwuebuka-2003 @kuishou68 @BambaSatoru @Yi-111-a @cosark @muskanbandta23 @cosmind-rusu @samki6576
